title: Carriage
abstract: To provide a carriage capable of limiting speed with respect to excessive operations.SOLUTION: A carriage 1 includes: a vehicle body 2; omnidirectional wheels 3; a drive unit 4; a handle 5; a force sensor 6 for detecting a longitudinal load and a lateral load applied to the handle; and a control device 7 for controlling the drive unit according to the longitudinal load and the lateral load detected by the force sensor. The control device sets a target longitudinal speed provisional value of the vehicle body according to the longitudinal load, and sets a target lateral speed provisional value of the vehicle body according to the lateral load. If the target longitudinal speed provisional value is equal to a longitudinal speed upper limit value or higher, or if the target lateral speed provisional value is equal to a lateral speed upper limit value or higher, the control device multiplies a correction factor set to be larger than 0 and equal to or smaller than 1 by the target longitudinal speed provisional value in setting the target longitudinal speed, and multiplies the correction factor by the target lateral provisional value in setting the target lateral speed, in order to control the drive unit according to the target longitudinal speed and the target lateral speed.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

以上の実施形態によれば、目標前後速度暫定値ｖｔｐ１が前後速度上限値ｖｕ１以上、又は目標左右速度暫定値ｖｔｐ２が左右速度上限値ｖｕ２以上である場合に、補正係数ｋｖが設定され、目標前後速度ｖｔ１及び目標左右速度ｖｔ２が抑制される。これにより、過剰な操作に対して速度を制限することができる台車１を提供することができる。
According to the above embodiment, when the target longitudinal speed provisional value vtp1 is equal to or greater than the longitudinal speed upper limit value vu1 or the target lateral speed provisional value vtp2 is equal to or greater than the lateral speed upper limit value vu2, the correction coefficient kv is set and the target longitudinal speed The speed vt1 and the target lateral speed vt2 are suppressed. As a result, it is possible to provide the trolley 1 capable of limiting the speed against excessive operation.

また、目標前後速度暫定値ｖｔｐ１と目標左右速度暫定値ｖｔｐ２とが共通の補正係数ｋｖによって補正されるため、目標前後速度ｖｔ１と目標左右速度ｖｔ２との比率が、目標前後速度暫定値ｖｔｐ１と目標左右速度暫定値ｖｔｐ２との比率と同じになる。さらに、電動モータ２５のうち１つ以上の目標回転速度暫定値ｒｔｐが最大回転速度ｒｍより大きくても、目標前後速度ｖｔ１と目標左右速度ｖｔ２との比率と目標角速度ωｔとが変化しないように、電動モータ２５のそれぞれの目標回転速度暫定値ｒｔｐを最大回転速度ｒｍ以下の値に補正する。これにより、速度が抑制されるときにも、台車１の進行方向が維持される。また、使用者の操作力に関わらず目標角速度ωｔは制限されない。そのため、使用者の意図に沿った台車１の旋回が可能になる。これらにより、図７に示すように、台車１の速度が制限される場合には、台車１の速度が制限されない場合と比べて、各時間における台車１の向きは等しくなる。
Further, since the target longitudinal speed provisional value vtp1 and the target lateral speed provisional value vtp2 are corrected by the common correction coefficient kv, the ratio between the target longitudinal speed vt1 and the target lateral speed vt2 is equal to the target longitudinal speed provisional value vtp1 and the target lateral speed provisional value vtp1. It becomes the same as the ratio with the left/right speed provisional value vtp2. Furthermore, even if one or more target rotational speed provisional values rtp of the electric motors 25 are greater than the maximum rotational speed rm, the ratio between the target longitudinal speed vt1 and the target lateral speed vt2 and the target angular speed ωt do not change. The provisional target rotational speed value rtp of each of the electric motors 25 is corrected to a value equal to or lower than the maximum rotational speed rm. Thereby, the traveling direction of the truck 1 is maintained even when the speed is suppressed. Also, the target angular velocity ωt is not limited regardless of the user's operating force. Therefore, it is possible to turn the cart 1 in accordance with the user's intention. As a result, as shown in FIG. 7, when the speed of the truck 1 is limited, the orientation of the truck 1 at each time is the same as when the speed of the truck 1 is not limited.

目標角速度ωｔの基準点が一対の全方向車輪３の中点に配置されているため、台車１を効率良く旋回させることができる。
Since the reference point of the target angular velocity ωt is arranged at the midpoint of the pair of omnidirectional wheels 3, the truck 1 can be turned efficiently.
